notes: The author declared survival in nature as the focus, but the described game is several player-controlled animals roaming a forest and attacking each other, which none of Survival's shapes or presets describes — there is no killer, disaster, escape or crafting loop — so I overrode the declaration, led with Roleplay & Avatar Sim's Animal Sim and named Survival second as the skill asks when overriding. Shape is wilderness-open because this is a natural biome of forest, vegetation and rivers with no settlement, inhabited as creatures, and it holds a map the author wants large but crossable in a few minutes on one continuous surface. From Animal Sim I kept den-shelter and landmark-focal, which a large map needs for orientation, and dropped social-hub since the stated loop is surviving and attacking rather than gathering; I took water-body for the several rivers because they are named twice and structure the map, and Survival's cover-los becomes the dense undergrowth animals stalk and break sightlines in. Deciding without a user: the only movement stated is walk, run, jump and strike, so nothing swims and the rivers sit on one representable surface — the volumetric CHECK water normally carries is a flag for the pipeline rather than a real cost here, and the realism and texture requests are art direction rather than layout.
